identity.real_world_identity_notes: The Cadillac V-Series.R is an LMDh prototype using the category's seven-speed sequential hybrid transmission. The base AMS2 identity was live-tested; Low Downforce is an explicit aero-package alias inheriting those controls and was not separately tested.

wheel_rim.notes: Direct cockpit inspection showed a closed GT/Formula rim with an integrated display. Shift lights were not explicitly checked.

notes: With simulator assists disabled, the modeled hybrid car moved from rest without physical clutch input.
All seven paddle-selected gears accepted clutch-free no-lift upshifts with automatic cut and clutch-free downshifts with automatic blip.
Cadillac V-Series.R - Low Downforce inherits the verified base controls as an approved aero-package assumption and was not separately live-tested.
The base configuration was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with simulator assists disabled.
Low Downforce is an exact observed identity inheriting base controls; that aero configuration was not separately live-tested.

confidence.basis: The exact base identity, seven gears, hybrid move-off, paddle controls, automatic cut/blip, and GT/Formula display rim were directly tested. Low Downforce is explicitly marked as inherited.

claims.basis: Official release context and exact live telemetry establish the base and Low Downforce identities.
Primary LMDh gearbox evidence and direct exercise of all seven paddle-selected gears agree.
Direct testing established hybrid move-off, automatic cut/blip, and the cockpit rim; wheel shift lights remain unknown.

notes: Low Downforce is an exact approved alias whose controls are inherited from the verified base; it has not been separately live-tested.

The wheel-rim shape was originally recorded as "prototype", a value that named a racing category rather than a rim outline. That value is retired: the rims it covered are the same closed form, flattened at both the top and the bottom, that the project now records as "gt-style". The shape was remapped by definition and the rim was not observed again.

The wheel-rim shape was originally recorded as "gt-style". The separate "gt-style", "formula" and "prototype" values described the same rim: molded grips at 9 and 3 with a control face between them, usually carrying a display and rev lights. They are merged into "gt-formula". The rim was not observed again and nothing about the observation changed.
driver_summary: Paddle sequential that asks for no clutch at any point: it gets away from rest, cuts the upshift and blips the downshift itself. Once you are in the car the gearbox is not your problem.
